title: Dia Browser hero
description: A window-tall hero washed in sunlit gold: a white, tightly tracked serif statement near the top, the product's name set enormous in the same serif behind a wide browser window that rises over its lower half, and a cream arc curving up from the bottom edge with a long black waitlist pill. On desktop the window slides up 140px as you start to scroll.
notes: sized by the window (100svh, at least 600px); the window placeholder is cropped by the fold like the original
backdrop and media are placeholders for a photo/canvas and a product clip
the headline and name are light type scoped with the dark class: they need a mid-to-deep highlight colour behind them
leaves ~90px at the top for the fixed diabrowser-header
docked: hides its own arc bar from lg when diabrowser-waitlist-dock wraps the page
